exposure: acid suppressants (proton pump inhibitors, histamine-2 receptor antagonists, before age 2 years)
cohort: Children born between October 2001 and September 2012 in the Military Health System, enrolled in TRICARE past age 2 years and within 35 days of birth, with an initial hospital stay <7 days, and without psychotropic agents dispensed during the first 2 years of life.
finding: Children prescribed antibiotics and acid suppressants in the first 2 years of life had a significantly increased risk of future psychotropic prescriptions, with a dose-related effect observed.
followup_time: up to age 10 years for the youngest participants; mean age at first psychotropic prescription was 6.8 years
